Checked Oct 1, 2026. Confirmed against the sources at the foot of this page. Check the host’s page before you go

How we know

The shop’s blog post ‘Rob and Charlies 2026 Group Ride Sundays’ gives coffee 8:30 and rollout 9:00, and the shop’s homepage was posting news dated late September 2026; Santa Fe Seniors on Bikes’ page points to the same ride and its Strava club (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

Hosted by
Rob and Charlie’s Bike ShopBike shop
Kind of ride
Road

For visitors

Helmet required. The shop says it is for intermediate and advanced riders who know group etiquette and can fix a flat. It is not a no-drop ride, but the group regroups several times. Bring plenty to eat and drink. Seniors on Bikes says the ride splits into faster and shorter groups as it goes.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Expect 14–17 mph: brisk — you’ll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Rob and Charlie’s Sunday Group Ride group ride

Rob and Charlie’s Sunday Group Ride is a road group ride in Santa Fe, NM. It rolls every Sunday at 9:00 am from Rob and Charlie’s Bike Shop, St. Michael’s Village West.

The shop’s open Sunday ride out of St. Michael’s Village. Expect a social but steady pace over 45 to 65 miles, two abreast where roads allow. The group tends to split into faster and shorter groups on the road.
